## Tester Profile

- **Testing Context**: [e.g. Agency, In-House SEO, Open-Source Contributor, Independent Developer]
- **Deployment Mode**: [e.g. `npx open-semrush`, Docker Compose, Self-hosted Node]
- **Platform / Architecture**: [e.g. Ubuntu 24.04 x64, macOS M2, Windows 11 x64]

## Crawl & Audit Experience

- **Site Type Tested**: [e.g. E-commerce, SPA / React, News/Blog, Static HTML, Multi-lingual]
- **Scale Tested**: [e.g. Single page, 10-50 pages, 500+ pages]
- **Estimated Audit Time / Responsiveness**: [e.g. Fast (<1s/page), Average, Slow]

## Findings & Evaluation

- **Accuracy Feedback**: [Did the audit identify real issues? Were there false positives or false negatives?]
- **Feature Usability**: [What felt smooth? What was confusing or missing?]
- **AI Recommendation Quality**: [If AI recommendations were enabled, how relevant and actionable were they?]

## Suggested Enhancements or Issues Encountered

Provide any constructive suggestions, edge cases, or logs (ensure all private URLs/tokens are redacted).
